rows.text: Hey, who are you? This is the restoration room of the museum, nothing here is on display...
rows.speaker: Boris

rows.text: Miss Pela sent you to help...
rows.speaker: Boris

rows.text: Oh, now I remember! Haha, my forgetfulness!
rows.speaker: Boris

rows.text: Pleased to meet you, I'm the museum's artifact restorer, Boris! So sorry for not recognizing you earlier.
rows.speaker: Boris
